title: Oh My God Bro, Oh Hell Nah
blurb: 'Oh my god bro. Oh hell nah, man.' — the two-stage rejection of something too cursed to process. Stage one: disbelief. Stage two: refusal. The delivery is so wearily authentic that it fits any horror, from actual jumpscares to seeing the group project submission. When one 'nah' isn't enough, this is the certified escalation package.
origin: A viral two-part disbelief reaction clip.
